thesis: Dossier shows PAT +562% YoY and P/E 11, but these come from trading-income volatility, not an industry/company inflection chain. EBITDA margin of 112% is a data artefact of treating trading gains as revenue. CFO/PAT -0.56 and receivables +28.5% versus revenue +7.0% (latest FY) are weak. The new filings are rating housekeeping (Acuite withdrawal after the company switched to CRISIL) and a Rs200cr warrant raise. Cheap on trailing earnings, but earnings are cyclical and lumpy; no demand/supply/pricing link demonstrated. Wait for Q1 FY27 results text and normalised earnings.

valuation: TTM P/E 11.1, EV/EBITDA 7.6, market cap Rs3,934cr, price 21% below 52w high (CALCULATIONS). Low multiple reflects cyclical, trading-driven profit.

kill_conditions: Q2 FY27 PAT falls below Rs50cr-equivalent run-rate of FY26 average with falling client/F&O volumes
Warrant issue priced at a deep discount to market or to non-promoter investors with weak disclosure
Adverse SEBI order on proprietary/algo trading or a further CFO deterioration
biggest_risk: Profit is trading-driven and mean-reverting, with negative operating cash flow; low P/E may be a value trap.
